description: Refactor the observable subscription model: use_observable/1 resolves a server and returns a pid (nil when disconnected); use_projection/3 registers a named projection against that pid, handles disconnected fallback, and returns the projected value. Server-side fan-out is keyed by owner_pid — one subscription per LiveView per server, stacked projections delivered in one batched message per notify_observers call. Projection dedup (last_projected) moves from per-subscriber to per-projection within the stacked map.
title: Split use_observable into use_observable (pid) + use_projection
